ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the exam date for the post of Scientist / Engineer. This recruitment was released for 175 posts. Online applying process for ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 August 2026 to 16 September 2026. The CBT examination is going to conducted on 19 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their IISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 from the link given below

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026?

ISRO ICRB Scientist / Engineer Exam Date 2026 is an official government recruitment / examination notification. Complete details including eligibility, important dates, and direct links are provided above.

Where can I find the official link?

The official link is: https://www.isro.gov.in/

How to apply online?

Click on the Apply Online link given above, register on the official portal, fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee before the last date.
